architecture_drift.warning: The architecture agent is non-deterministic and produced a THIRD distinct shape for the same profile. This run emitted NO I2C net at all (U2's request carries interfaces: []), so the AD4057-on-an-I2C-bus case that motivated the fix DOES NOT RECUR HERE. This capture therefore does not, and cannot, demonstrate the fix's effect on that specific case -- the requirement that exposed it was never generated. The fix is verified directly against U2's captured v3 shortlist instead, and by the verified-absence-outranking-unknown regression test.
